title: What my Senja spec forgot: 32/32 checks passed, 11 gaps found #shorts
description:
Claude passed all 32 acceptance checks building a Senja alternative, a testimonial wall, from one written spec. The build still exposed 11 gaps in the spec, like a second moderator silently replacing the featured quote, and a quote starting with = running as a formula in the CSV export. All 11 are now fixed.

Full build test (3:03): https://youtu.be/VLkozMFK8xU
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/testimonial-wall
Senja pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/senja

Senja prices: Free $0 (15 testimonials), Starter $29/month, Pro $59/month (senja.io/pricing, October 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
